logp.method_description: The log Po/w values were estimated by the shake-flask method33 where a compound is shaken in an n-octanol-water 450 mixture, and after equilibrium, the concentration in one phase is measured. The compounds were dissolved at a concentration of 0.3 mg/mL in 4 mL of n-octanol, except cisplatin was dissolved in the aqueous phase. Instead of water, phosphate buffered saline (PBS) was used to suppress the hydrolysis of the chloride ligands.35 An equal volume of PBS was added to the n-octanol, and the solutions were shaken mechanically for 24 h. After separation, the phases were analyzed by UV-Vis spectroscopy to determine 460 the amount of compound in each phase. The absorption values before and after shaking were compared and based on the Lambert-Beer Law, the concentration ratio in both phases for each compound was calculated to determine the logP values.
